records.key: File/folder: Drop an image or a folder of images to see tools that accept it.
records.source: File/folder: Drop an image or a folder of images to see tools that accept it.
records.translation: Arquivo/pasta: Solte uma imagem ou uma pasta de imagens para ver ferramentas que aceitam essa entrada.

records.key: Path: Paste {folder} or {image} to see compatible tools. You can also type a file type, such as tif.
records.source: Path: Paste {folder} or {image} to see compatible tools. You can also type a file type, such as tif.
records.translation: Caminho: Cole {folder} ou {image} para ver ferramentas compatíveis. Você também pode digitar um tipo de arquivo, como tif.

records.key: Question: Try “segment images” to find segmentation tools.
records.source: Question: Try “segment images” to find segmentation tools.
records.translation: Pergunta: Experimente “segmentar imagens” para encontrar ferramentas de segmentação.

records.key: Module: Type “Measure” to find the measurement module.
records.source: Module: Type “Measure” to find the measurement module.
records.translation: Módulo: Digite “Measure” para encontrar o módulo de medição.

records.key: Explore: Click a card to see tools that can use its output or supply its input. Open the tool you want to use.
records.source: Explore: Click a card to see tools that can use its output or supply its input. Open the tool you want to use.
records.translation: Explorar: Clique em um cartão para ver ferramentas que podem usar sua saída ou fornecer sua entrada. Abra a ferramenta que deseja usar.

records.key: spaCR AI: Ask for help with your spaCR analysis, e.g., ‘How do I generate object masks?’ or ‘How do i train a Cellpose or Torch model?’
records.source: spaCR AI: Ask for help with your spaCR analysis, e.g., ‘How do I generate object masks?’ or ‘How do i train a Cellpose or Torch model?’
records.translation: spaCR AI: Peça ajuda com sua análise de spaCR; por exemplo, ‘Como gero máscaras de objetos?’ ou ‘Como treino um modelo Cellpose ou Torch?’
